speaker: edmund_tilney
text: I have the king open at the fourth act. I have read every line. You may sit. The question is not the chronicle.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: What will a yard be made to see, and what only to hear?

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Here cousin, seize the Crowne.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: It is a pretty play. The fourth act is prettiest where it is shortest.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Leave out the deposing of the King in the Parliament, & only report it. I am writing that in the margin, in my hand.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The bishop's protest may stand. Then from the quarrel straight to Conuey him to the Tower. Nobody is to see a crown change hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is all in the chronicle.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The chronicle is read by one man, sitting. This would be heard by two thousand, standing, a fortnight after a gallows at the Lord Mayor's gate.

speaker: john_heminges
text: York may bring word of it. That is the report. The yard does not see the act.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: York may bring word. I have said the same. I will sign the last leaf, and I will seal it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Seven shillings. Set by on the first of July. I am counting them down. The cutting is the Master's, and not ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fee is the company's. I am not writing it as a new sum of mine. The foul papers stay in my coffer at home. The deposing stays in them.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The book I am sealing is the book the yard may hear. What you keep at home is your own paper. I am not licensing a second play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One book goes out with the seal. The other does not come into this room. I will not have two kings on one table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One king on your table. The uncut copy is not here. I did not bring it.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Courteous, and not late for the licence. The seal is down.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Down, and the seven with it. The margin is yours, sir, and the fee is paid from what was already set.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have nothing to add to the margin. The chronicle was my whole argument. You have answered it.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: A line down the margin, in my hand. The words of the scene under it are not for the yard. The line is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see the line. I am not reading the scene out against it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Seven, counted, not a new bargain. The first of July still holds.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The first of July may hold whatever purse you please. My hand is for the book in front of me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the book in front of you is the public one. I am taking no copy of your margin home except in my head.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Your head, and my count. That is enough to leave with.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Leave. The seal will dry without an audience.
